summary: Uniti Group Inc. filed an 8-K on June 1, 2026, announcing a $1,140.71 million offering of secured fiber network revenue term notes by its subsidiary Kinetic ABS Issuer LLC. The notes are unregistered and offered to QIBs under Rule 144A and offshore under Regulation S. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including capital expenditures or debt repayment. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation like a tender or restructuring.
